queens.name: Queens
queens.rules: Place one queen in each row, each column and each colored region. Two queens can never touch, not even diagonally.
queens.howTo: Tap a cell to place a queen, tap it twice for a cross. Drag your finger to cross out several cells.

today.title: Daily puzzle
today.updateAvailable: A Griday update may be available: install it to keep playing the same grids as everyone else.
today.newPuzzle: A new daily puzzle is available.

unlimited.title: Unlimited mode
unlimited.empty: Pick a size and a difficulty, then start a new grid.

game.resetConfirm: Clear every mark from the grid? You can undo this, and the timer keeps running.

victory.title: Well done!
victory.archive: Archive puzzle: it doesn’t count toward your streak.

single.region: The highlighted region has only one possible cell left: its queen must go there.
single.row: Row {{row}} has only one possible cell left: its queen must go there.
single.column: Column {{col}} has only one possible cell left: its queen must go there.

region-line.row: All possible cells of the highlighted region are in row {{row}}. That row’s queen will therefore be in the region, so the other cells of row {{row}} are ruled out.
region-line.column: All possible cells of the highlighted region are in column {{col}}. That column’s queen will therefore be in the region, so the other cells of column {{col}} are ruled out.

line-region.row: All possible cells of row {{row}} are in the same region. That region’s queen will therefore be in row {{row}}, so its other cells are ruled out.
line-region.column: All possible cells of column {{col}} are in the same region. That region’s queen will therefore be in column {{col}}, so its other cells are ruled out.

locked.regions-rows: These {{count}} regions only have possible cells in rows {{lines}}: their {{count}} queens will fill those rows. Every other cell in those rows is ruled out.
locked.regions-columns: These {{count}} regions only have possible cells in columns {{lines}}: their {{count}} queens will fill those columns. Every other cell in those columns is ruled out.
locked.rows-regions: Rows {{lines}} only have possible cells in {{count}} regions: their queens will be those regions’ queens. Every other cell in those regions is ruled out.
locked.columns-regions: Columns {{lines}} only have possible cells in {{count}} regions: their queens will be those regions’ queens. Every other cell in those regions is ruled out.
locked.rows-columns: Rows {{lines}} only have possible cells in columns {{targets}}: their queens will fill those columns. Every other cell in those columns is ruled out.
locked.columns-rows: Columns {{lines}} only have possible cells in rows {{targets}}: their queens will fill those rows. Every other cell in those rows is ruled out.

queens.contradiction: Suppose there is a queen on the marked cell: following the simple deductions, {{unit}} would have no possible cell left. That is impossible, so this cell is ruled out.
queens.reveal: No simple deduction here: here is one queen of the solution.
queens.mistake_one: One cell is wrong: it is outlined on the grid. Fix it before going on.
queens.mistake_other: {{count}} cells are wrong: they are outlined on the grid. Fix them before going on.
queens.attack_one: A queen on the marked cell would remove every possible cell of {{unit}}, leaving it without a queen: this cell is ruled out.
queens.attack_other: A queen on any of the {{count}} marked cells would remove every possible cell of {{unit}}, leaving it without a queen: these cells are ruled out.

dynamicColor.title: Dynamic colors
dynamicColor.description: Use the colors of your wallpaper

autoCross.title: Automatic crosses
autoCross.description: Cross out the cells ruled out by each queen

patterns.title: Region patterns
patterns.description: Add a texture to each region to tell them apart (color blindness)

errors.generation: The grid could not be prepared. Please try again.
errors.engineCheck: This device computes grids differently: your daily puzzle might not match other players’.
errors.hint: Couldn’t work out a hint. Try again.
errors.screen: Something went wrong on this screen. Retrying reloads it and resets its current puzzle.

streak.freezeEarned: Streak freeze earned! It will protect your streak on a missed day.

archive.title: Archive
archive.subtitle: Puzzles from past days, to play whenever you like.
archive.empty: Past puzzles will show up here starting tomorrow, so you can play or catch up on them whenever you like.

empty.title: No statistics yet
empty.body: Solve your first puzzle to see your times, your streak and your progress here.

streak.title: Current streak
streak.atRisk: Solve today’s puzzle before midnight to keep your streak.
streak.start: Solve today’s puzzle to start a streak.

freezes.title: Streak freezes
freezes.explain: A freeze protects your streak when you miss a day. You earn one every {{every}} days of streak (up to {{max}}).

recent.label: Times of your last {{n}} daily puzzles, from {{from}} to {{to}}: from {{min}} to {{max}}, the latest in {{last}}.
recent.needMore: Solve at least two daily puzzles to see how your times evolve.

reminder.title: Daily reminder
reminder.description: One notification a day, unless today’s puzzle is already solved
reminder.denied: Notifications are turned off for Griday. Allow them in Android settings (Apps › Griday › Notifications).

notification.title: Puzzle #{{n}} is ready
notification.body: A fresh grid to solve in a few minutes.
